characters. The API stores two WebP versions without the EXIF data. A
profile takes up to eight photos.

info.title: SaStrane API
info.description:
The API of SaStrane, a marketplace for small local jobs.

Endpoints marked with a lock need an access token in the Authorization
header. Login, email verification and refresh return one. The refresh token
travels only in the httpOnly cookie sastrane_refresh, which the
browser sends to /api/auth.

same status: EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED,
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_PENDING, LISTING_CLOSED,
APPLICATION_ALREADY_DECIDED, INVALID_IMAGE, PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED or
WRONG_PASSWORD. The other codes of a route are listed with its errors.
